answer:
Based on my research, the Moderna Museet in Stockholm presented the following **singular artist exhibitions focusing on deceased artists in 2022**:

1. **"The Surrounding Reality"** - Björn Lövin (February 4 – September 18, 2022)
   - Björn Lövin was a Swedish artist who passed away in 2017, making him deceased at the time of this exhibition.

2. **"The Ten Largest"** - Hilma af Klint (September 22, 2022 – January 8, 2023)
   - Hilma af Klint was one of Sweden's most significant abstract artists who died in 1944, well before this major retrospective was held.

Both exhibitions featured artists who were deceased at the time the shows opened at the Moderna Museet in 2022. These retrospectives honored the legacies of these important artists through displays of their work.
